text.en:
Upon readying within 3.5 seconds of getting kills while this weapon is stowed:
+10 Handling, +10 Reload Speed, and +10 Stability per stack for 7.5 seconds.

Stacks up to 3 times. Buff is removed on stow.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased to 8.5 seconds.
)

< table formula wide background_2 >
|b Stacks |b Reload Speed |b Ready Speed |b Stow Speed
|b 1x | <formula [reload_0] /> | <formula [ready_0] /> | <formula [stow_0] />
|b 2x | <formula [reload_1] /> | <formula [ready_1] /> | <formula [stow_1] />
|b 3x | <formula [reload_2] /> | <formula [ready_2] /> | <formula [stow_2] />
<$>
text.zh-chs:
此武器收起时使用武器或技能完成最后一击，并在 3.5 秒内拔出此武器：
每层增益 +10 操控性，+10 填装速度，+10 稳定性，持续 7.5 秒。

最多叠加 3 层。收枪时移除该增益。

enhanced (
#e 增益持续时间提升到 8.5 秒。
)

< table formula wide background_2 >
|b 层数 |b 填装时间 |b 拔枪速度 |b 收枪速度
|b 1x | <formula [reload_0] /> | <formula [ready_0] /> | <formula [stow_0] />
|b 2x | <formula [reload_1] /> | <formula [ready_1] /> | <formula [stow_1] />
|b 3x | <formula [reload_2] /> | <formula [ready_2] /> | <formula [stow_2] />
<$>

var d = 1

Scoring any Kill while the weapon is stowed grants a "trigger stack" for 3.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Readying the weapon with active "trigger stacks" converts them to Stacks of 'Sleight of Hand' with a #e${7.5+#d} second duration.

Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of 'Sleight of Hand':
10|20|30 Handling, Reload Speed, and Stability

Buff is removed on stow.
